phase: P6 fulfillment idempotency after checkpoint recovery

assertions: the recovered session accepts the same fulfillment command
the repeated fulfillment reports no checkpoint change
the response matches the committed fulfillment response
the checkpoint remains byte-for-byte equivalent as a value

limitations: Java 21 and Java 25 both compiled the current Paper sources and ran the test. This is a checkpoint-recovery idempotency test, not a process-kill test at the exact factory-checkpoint versus relay-receipt boundary. Proxy runtime behavior remains unverified.
